sentence: Studies how large-scale patterns in the ocean and atmosphere are linked to heavy rainfall and high sea levels, to improve forecasting tools.
Builds artificial intelligence tools that find similar shapes between new part designs and parts that have already been successfully manufactured.
Studies how to judge the value of information and designs systems that get people to share good information and combine it.
Uses seismic imaging to compare the deep structure of ancient continental regions and find out how they have changed over time.
Studies shapes using calculus and equations, asking how geometric objects behave and how singularities form.
Builds a deep learning tool that finds breast cancer in ultrasound images with few annotations and picks the most useful images for training.
Uses tiny carbon nanotube sensors to measure levels of hydrogen peroxide and nitric oxide outside cells.
Tries to find out how to make computer science and robotics lessons work better for all young learners, including those with disabilities.
Tries to find crypto-ransomware, which locks files by encrypting them, by studying logs of how a system behaves as it runs.
Studies how data left behind by earlier users of shared cloud hardware can leak through tiny physical effects, and looks for ways to stop it.
Builds an eye-tracking system that helps detect diseases of the nervous system, using several cameras and no manual calibration.
Builds mathematical tools to work out how messenger RNA is moved and organized inside living cells from microscopy images.
Studies how mineral buildup and organic matter sticking to a membrane affect each other when salty water is made fresh by reverse osmosis.
Studies how to detect and locate events using a network of quantum sensors that are linked together.
Studies shapes called moduli spaces that come from the math behind elementary particles, and how their geometric and algebraic properties fit together.
Brings faculty together to work out how to cover the technical and human sides of cybersecurity in their courses.
Upgrades a college's computer network and security equipment to protect sensitive data and keep research and courses running.
Studies how the brain learns to control the tongue, lips and jaws to say new words and keep speech accurate.
